items.question: Why do indexes slow down writes?
items.answer: Indexes slow down writes because each insert or update must also change the index, and indexes use extra disk space [S1].

supplied_sources.S3: A B-tree index keeps keys in sorted order, so equality and range queries can find rows without scanning the whole table.
